text:
Palladium Price in 2016
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2016, the LBMA palladium price rose 33.7% between 2016-01-29 ($501) and 2016-12-29 ($670). The highest sampled price was $770 in November and the lowest was $494 in February. The mean of these observations was $623. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
